issues.title: PR-0066 (carried, narrowed and downgraded from major; absorbs FOC18-03): on the 390x844 chapter select v2, five text runs render at 12 px, below the 14 px floor
issues.chapter: title and chapter select (gates all eight tiles)
issues.state: title and chapter select, 390x844, fresh context
issues.requirement: critic/CHECKS.md CHK-003 pass/fail "zero elements under 14px"; RUBRIC §2 platform goals (phone is a supported shape).
issues.expected: CHK-003 and the change's own acceptance: no text a player must read falls below 14 effective css px, and the title still composes at 390x844.
issues.observed: the 'Chapter select' heading, 'Chapter I', '/13', 'CTB' and 'Final Fantasy X' render at 12 px on the candidate; live measures 12 px on the same 390x844 board
issues.observedEarlier: At 390x844 the chapter board reports 22 visible leaf text nodes at 9.54 effective px — the three party names, the LOCATION / BOSS / PARTY / BEST keys, the chapter numerals, the CTB badge, both visible "Coming" badges and all four control hints — with the chapter numeral at 10.27 and the chapter prose and boss line at 11.74. The title reports 9.54 for the eyebrow "An unofficial fan tribute" and for "Arrows / WASD", "Enter" and "Esc". At 1600x900 the same sweep has a minimum of 14.44 and at 2000x1012 of 16.24, so only the narrow breakpoint fails. Explicitly NOT a defect: fe-title__strap reports -14.44 / -16.24 because the measuring helper multiplies by matrix.a = -1 on the rotated vertical rail; the rail reads correctly at |eff| 14.44.
issues.repro: Fresh browser context at 390x844 with no resize down from a larger size. Load the live site, press Enter (or tap the chip) to reach the chapter select, walk every leaf text node under .fe and multiply getComputedStyle(el).fontSize by the accumulated transform scale. No seed involved.
issues.confidence: high — measured on the live bundle, and the mechanism is traced in the shipped CSS
issues.fix: src/app/screens/frontend/frontend.css:779 re-bases --fe-k to max(0.5px, min(100vw/430, 100vh/1150)) = 0.7339 at 390x844, and the smallest declared token is 13, so the floor is 13 x 0.7339 = 9.54. Smallest useful correction: stop letting --fe-k drive TYPE below the floor while it still drives layout — give the type tokens their own clamp inside the narrow media query, e.g. font-size: max(14px, calc(13 * var(--fe-k))), and let the phone column reflow rather than shrink. Do not raise --fe-k globally: the slab and rail geometry in the same block depend on it. Game case: BOTH — one shared front end.
issues.acceptanceCheck: In a fresh 390x844 context the leaf-text sweep over .fe on both the title and the chapter select returns zero elements under 14 effective px, documentElement.scrollWidth === clientWidth, and the re-shot capture shows no clipped or overlapping labels; the same sweep at 1600x900 and 2000x1012 is unchanged.

issues.title: The Berserk bench seeds do not transfer to play, and 20 in-game runs of the Chapter 5 Leg link landed Berserk on nobody
issues.state: the reviewer's own instrumentation, not the product
issues.requirement: RUBRIC §5: match proof to the claim — a seeded engine fixture cannot stand in for the shipped seeding.
issues.expected: A seed that makes the bench land Berserk makes the shipped chapter land it, so the player-facing half of PR-0052 can be captured.
issues.observed: Two facts block that capture and both belong in the record. (1) z06-passes and z06-berserk construct an isolated vegnagun-leg battle with engine.setSeed(n), while in shipped play each link is seeded from the chapter run (docs/DEV.md: engines are seeded per battle via BattleSetup.seed), so __pyrefly.setSeed(13) before chapter 5 is not the bench's seed 13. The seed-finder confirms the bench-side hits (seeds 3, 13, 27, 36, 38 put Yuna in White Mage under Berserk, earliest at turn 8) but they address the fixture, not the game. (2) Twenty in-game seeds (1-20) were swept, skipping link 1 and watching link 2 at normal speed, polling battleState about every 300 ms. The Leg link was reached in all 20 runs and Berserk was applied to nobody in any of them, although the AI path is live (src/battle/ffx2/ai/vegnagun.ts:72-87 rolls 1-in-3 Berserk / Break / Slow, and Slow was observed landing on Yuna on link 2 in a diagnostic run) and the bench predicts Berserk on a party member in about 6 of 24 isolated Leg battles. A false hypothesis was chased and discarded: legAction1 asks for "leg-berserk" while the registry holds "x2-vegnagun-leg-berserk", but re-running z06-legai proves the unprefixed ids do fire (19 leg-berserk casts over 24 seeds), so there is no id-resolution bug.
issues.repro: critic/rounds/round-06/gap-berserk.mjs and gap-berserk2.mjs (in-game sweep); critic/rounds/round-06/bench/z06-gap-seeds.test.ts (seed finder).
issues.confidence: High on both measurements. The discrepancy between 6-in-24 predicted and 0-in-20 observed is unexplained and is the thing to reconcile; it may be the harness's sampling, the chapter seeding, or a real difference between the fixture and the shipped link.
issues.fix: Expose the per-link seed the chapter actually used through the debug API (or let __pyrefly.setSeed apply per link), so a bench seed can be reproduced in play. Then re-run the sweep and either capture the Berserked turn for PR-0052 or explain the difference.

results.title: Following the advisor on the fresh-profile seed loses Chapter XII
results.note: Confirmed from the round-13 evidence, which I re-read. I did not replay it live. combat/bench-ffx.log (shipped b975397b, 40 seeds) has seymour-omnis intended at 27/40, where seed 1 is not among the losses, and advisor-top-row at 24/40, where seed 1 is among the losses. Live run.json at 2000x1012 (battleSeed 1, gpu mode) shows 2 defeats, at 59 and 88 turns. The phone run at 390x844 (seed 1) lost attempt 1 in 71 turns and won attempt 2. The advisor line is weaker than the intended line and loses the seed every fresh profile gets. It is a defect in a newly listed chapter, so it does not block and is not a regression against live. Two caveats: the live follower is a harness, not a person, and the 24 vs 27 gap over 40 seeds is small, so the solid points are 'seed 1 flips' and 'advisor < intended'.

results.title: The advisor tells a Zombie Yuna to drink an Elixir, and it KOs her
results.note: Confirmed from both live logs. In braskas-final-aeon-win the card (turn-log turn 244) read {label:'Elixir', target:'Yuna', menu:'Items'}. Yuna's Zombie status-add is at seq 1209 and is never removed. Elixir action-start is at seq 2371, damage to Yuna +5130 at seq 2373, and ko sourceId yuna at seq 2375. In r2 the card said the same at turn 256. Zombie is added at seq 1164, Elixir at 2353, damage 5130 at 2355 and the self-KO at 2357. research/ffx-bfa-yu-yevon.md row 100 (Triumphant Grasp form 1: Zombie 100%) supports the premise. One correction: the Phoenix Downs the card offered on her 'Zombie corpse' did revive her (revive events at 1516, 1568 and more in run 1; 1803, 1822 and more in r2). So that half is not a self-KO; the only harm is spending the turn. There is also an engine question to raise separately: Zombie survives KO and revive in the engine (no status-remove across 12 KOs). I have not checked that against the sources, so it is unverified whether FFX clears Zombie on KO. The engine bench is unchanged at 39/40, and introducedByCandidate and regressionVsLive stay unknown.

results.title: IC-2 confirmed live: an all-target move whose hit KOs a Redoubt moves its last hit onto the Head
results.note: Confirmed from the live Chapter V logs with an independent scan. I counted action-starts with more than one target where a target is KO'd mid-action and another target takes 0 hits. There were 4 in the nochange log, including Darkness by Paine at seq 2815: vegnagun-head 2 hits, redoubt-r 1, redoubt-l 0. There was 1 in the win log (Black Sky, seq 3503) and 8 in the win a2 log (Darkness at seq 1304, Rikku's Darkness at 1968). The code at b975397b in src/battle/ffx2/resolve.ts targetForHit re-filters the living targets on every hit and returns living[hitIndex % living.length]; line ~263 passes t. research/ffx2-combat-core.md §9.1 requires the target list to be taken once and hits never redirected. My narrower scan found 13 against the other reviewer's 23. The pattern is the same. The fix already exists on branch ffx2-engine-fixes-0926; do not duplicate it.

results.title: Acta Est Fabula heals the Vegnagun Head for 9,999 on every cast (live)
results.note: Confirmed. In all three live Chapter V logs, every Acta Est Fabula cast includes a negative damage (heal) event on vegnagun-head: 16/16 in nochange, 18/18 in win, 22/22 in win a2. research/ffx2-vegnagun-shuyin.md line 402 gives Acta's target as 'both Redoubts' only. This is FFX-2 only. It was already on live 1a680e41, so it is not a regression. The fix is on branch ffx2-engine-fixes-0926, awaiting Bailey's pick.

results.title: R13-C01 (IC-2 confirmed live): an all-target move whose target dies mid-move wraps its remaining hits onto a target already hit and skips a living one
results.note: This is the same defect as the IC-2 finding above; merge the two rather than counting them twice. My reproduction is the same scan, 13 wrap candidates across the 3 live Chapter V logs (seq 2815, 1304 and 1968 among them). The resolve.ts targetForHit code at b975397b matches the cited lines 116-122 and ~263. The rule in §9.1 of research/ffx2-combat-core.md reads as quoted. I did not re-run the Chapter IV/VI/XI bench, so the claim of 0 enemy-side cases in 480 chain runs is not re-verified here. Severity major, FFX-2 only, not a regression, and the fix already exists on the branch.
